description: Read reviewed GDP, inflation, jobs, trade, production, energy and credit packs with exact definitions, complete source flags, national qualifiers and observation-bound evidence. Set catalog=true to browse; otherwise provide an exact series_id and latest=true for its complete geography cohort or geo for history. Unreliable publisher values are withheld with raw_value retained. Reference periods and source publishing schedules vary.

as_of.description: Exact timestamp with timezone, up to six fractional digits. SOTW recorded transactions only.

catalog.description: true lists every reviewed definition (metadata only). Cannot be combined with other arguments.

format.description: json (default) returns observations; manifest returns the export manifest with checksums.

generation.description: Publication generation (UUID) from an earlier response, to keep reads on the same publication.

geo.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code or aggregate code (e.g. USA, DEU, EU27); with series_id, returns that geography's history.

latest.description: true returns the newest observation for every geography of series_id.

recorded.description: true reconstructs SOTW recorded state from archive activation onward.

revision.description: Positive bigint string returned by recorded_state. Preserve as text.

series_id.description: Exact definition ID from the catalog.

name: get_economic_data
